generation_notes: Deterministically synthesized from supplied OpENer protocol templates, operation catalog, and optional issue motifs to keep generation stable while preserving SRAG knowledge grounding. Scalable mode preserves source authority while allowing conservative model-prior completion for missing plan coverage. Generated exactly 4 PK-only candidate seeds (revised batch), one per supplied plan, using EtherNet/IP encapsulation with documented 24-byte headers and little-endian length fields. Because the supplied sources do not document CIP service-code values for Save, Restore, or Reset, those operations are represented as structurally valid explicit-message placeholders using conservative inferred CIP service bytes; these assumptions are explicitly recorded. To preserve framing validity and parser reachability, all explicit messages use SendRRData with the documented Null Address Item plus Unconnected Data Item CPF combination. No vulnerability or issue claims are made.
